entries.354731748439dd27: In the Textiles Business, the company holds the three major synthetic fibers—nylon, polyester and acrylic—and operates an integrated supply-chain business from textiles through to sewn products on a global basis. Its features are technological development capability, a diverse range of materials, supply-chain responsiveness and global business operations. In the Carbon Fiber Composite Materials Business, the company cites, in addition to over 50 years of research and development and data accumulation, a business structure that can propose and supply globally regular tow, offering the world’s highest performance and quality, and large tow, whose strength is cost competitiveness.

entries.38c7c1ba355e0a87: Under the medium-term management agenda “IGNITION 2028,” covering the three years from fiscal 2026 to fiscal 2028, the company says it will work on “enhancing economic value,” “enhancing social value” and “strengthening the management base.” Its policy is to continuously create high-profitability businesses and restructure low-profitability businesses. Examples cited include, in the Textiles Business, the integrated apparel business and the airbag business; in the Functional Chemicals Business, resins and functional films for xEVs and electronic information materials for semiconductor, electronic component and display applications; and, in the Carbon Fiber Composite Materials Business, expanding the customer base for aerospace, space and defense applications. The revenue target for fiscal 2028 is ¥3 trillion. In addition, the company says that from fiscal 2026 the Water Treatment Business and the Pharmaceuticals and Medical Business will be integrated and positioned as a segment called “Water Treatment & Healthcare.”

Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥894,423 million, the second largest after the Textiles Business. Revenue decreased 5.3% from the previous year. The company explains that resins were affected by sluggish market conditions for automotive uses, chemicals by deteriorating market conditions, and battery separator film by weak sales. On the other hand, films for electronic components and in-vehicle capacitor uses, and new electronic information materials for power inductors, saw sales increase. The main companies whose business category is printed only as Functional Chemicals are Toray Fine Chemicals Co., Ltd., Toray Film Processing Co., Ltd., Toray Plastics (America), Inc. (United States), and Toray Battery Separator Film Korea Limited (South Korea), among others.
